description: This file contains the implementation of the Bestseller class for the Opencart extension module, responsible for managing the bestseller products, including creating and deleting the related database table, editing totals, and retrieving reports.

classes.name: Bestseller
classes.description: A model class handling database operations related to bestseller products, including install/uninstall, update, delete, and report retrieval.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Creates the 'product_bestseller' database table if it does not exist.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Drops the 'product_bestseller' database table if it exists.

methods.name: editTotal
methods.description: Updates the total sales count for a specific product in the bestseller table.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a product's entry from the bestseller table.

methods.name: getReports
methods.description: Retrieves a list of bestseller products ordered by total sales, with pagination support.

methods.name: getTotalReports
methods.description: Returns the total number of bestseller records.
